payload.scientific_problem: test whether the unchanged integrated COMPOSE controller transfers from JAK2 development to PARP1 under the same strict delta=0.6 endpoint fiber
payload.primary_model_output: a target-reward-adapted selection over the union of complete executable shallow, anchored-replacement, and leave-PARP1-out route-distilled programs
payload.central_claim_under_test: the same multi-expert FiberControl algorithm can autonomously allocate docking calls on PARP1 without PARP1-specific controller changes
payload.experimental_setting: prospective three-cell PARP1 delta=0.6 cross-target development transfer; fixed 49-call ceiling per cell; candidate exhaustion and abstention are valid outcomes

frozen_from.forbidden_changes: proposal families, proposal widths, FiberControl features or fitting, expert-floor schedule, parent selection, exploration, endpoint gates, call budget, retries, or per-cell tuning

declared_support.objects: complete connected molecular endpoints produced by three executable COMPOSE proposal experts
declared_support.endpoint_support: compose_valid is a strict subset of the official T4 endpoint fiber

zero_oracle_route_support.result: complete-region programs committed on all three cells at precision 1.0; strict-eligible route endpoints were 4, 6, and 0 for PARP1-0, PARP1-1, and PARP1-2
zero_oracle_route_support.interpretation: preserved as a partial production-yield gate: route proposals can enter the union on two cells, while PARP1-2 route abstention remains a valid negative outcome and triggers no repair

promotion_criteria.transfer_signal: at least two cells reach their reported IVG delta=0.6 mean or one cell beats it by at least 0.5 while a second improves on its measured root
promotion_criteria.negative: two or more cells exhaust without an eligible non-root candidate, or all cells remain no better than their measured roots

payload.primary_baselines: read-only measured roots and reported IVG delta=0.6 values; no comparator value enters runtime
payload.claim_boundary: frozen cross-target PARP1 development transfer under one docking seed; route prior excludes PARP1, but the anchored expert was developed from answer-known JAK2 evidence; not held-out benchmark-wide evidence or a same-generator causal ablation

reported_ivg_source.aggregation: mean of the three published IVG run winners per exact cell, used only after the run for read-only comparison
